evidence.title: Mixo — AI Website Builder for Small Business
Mixo | AI Website Builder for Small Business

name: Mixo
summary: AI website builder that generates a multi-page small-business website from a short business description.
description: AI website builder for small businesses, service providers and solo operators. Describe your business and goals and Mixo generates a complete, mobile-friendly, multi-page website with content and contact forms in about 10 seconds; you then edit it in the Mixo editor and publish. Sites include contact forms, blog, SEO and managed hosting in 40+ languages. The free plan publishes a one-page site; paid upgrades unlock more pages, custom domains and advanced features.
contains: generates a multi-page website from a 1–2 sentence description in ~10 seconds
built-in contact forms with enquiry tracking and export
blog, SEO and GEO/AI search optimisation
managed hosting, custom domains, GDPR features
free plan for a one-page site; paid plans for more pages and custom domains
